Build a table in BigQuery from a SQL template

Source: R/build.R
jn_build_table.Rd

Renders inst/sql/<name>.sql with jn_sql(), reports the bytes the query will scan, writes the result to <project>.<dataset>.<name> (replacing it) and sets the column descriptions from jn_schema(). The article tables (articles, article_first_authors, article_agreements) are partitioned by pub_year, so queries for single years scan less. A table built with a different partitioning before is dropped first.

Usage

jn_build_table(
  name,
  config = jn_bq_config(),
  year_min = 2016L,
  year_max = as.integer(format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")),
  max_gb = 200,
  dry_run = FALSE
)

Arguments

name

Table and template name, e.g. "articles".

config

See jn_bq_config().

year_min, year_max

Publication years covered.

max_gb

Stop without running if the query would scan more than this.

dry_run

If TRUE, only report the bytes that would be scanned.

Value

The BigQuery table, invisibly (or the bytes, for a dry run).
